name: ServerSidePageFragmentComposition
summary: Builds one page from HTML fragments generated by several service-specific web applications, aggregated on the server.

roles.name: Fragment
roles.summary: The participant generating one region of the page, owned by the team that owns the service behind it. Its release cadence is its own, which is the point — and the page it lands in is somebody else's.

roles.name: PageTemplate
roles.summary: The template that assembles the fragments into a page. It is where a broken or slow fragment becomes a broken or slow page, and it is owned by a team that owns none of them.
